notes.title: Localization & Release Update
notes.notes:
[p][b]Launch Update[/b][/p][p]We’ve made the tough decision to delay the release of [i]Boomerang Jack[/i], now coming [b]a few months later than planned[/b]. Our goal has always been to deliver a polished, exciting adventure from day one, and we need a bit more time to make sure it’s the best it can be.
[/p][p]We’re also excited to confirm that [i]Boomerang Jack[/i] will launch with [b]full localization[/b] -- English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Italian, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Turkish and more! [/p][p]In the meantime, we’ll keep sharing progress updates and behind-the-scenes looks as we wrap up development. Thank you so much for your patience, your wishlists, and your support, it means the world to us and helps us bring [i]Boomerang Jack[/i] to life the right way.[/p][p]— The Recall Interactive Team[/p]
